description: Source code for GPIO driver for Renesas RZT2M microcontroller in Zephyr RTOS, implementing GPIO configuration, read/write, and lock/unlock functions.

methods.name: rzt2m_gpio_get_p_reg
methods.description: Returns pointer to port output data register.

methods.name: rzt2m_gpio_get_pin_reg
methods.description: Returns pointer to port input data register.

methods.name: rzt2m_gpio_get_pm_reg
methods.description: Returns pointer to port mode register.

methods.name: rzt2m_gpio_get_drctl_reg
methods.description: Returns pointer to IO buffer function switching register.

methods.name: rzt2m_gpio_get_rselp_reg
methods.description: Returns pointer to port region select register.

methods.name: rzt2m_gpio_init
methods.description: Initializes GPIO port, sets region to default.

methods.name: rzt2m_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets GPIO port bits with mask.

methods.name: rzt2m_gpio_configure
methods.description: Configures individual GPIO pin with flags.
